description: A pattern is admitted only where the asset type enables patterns, and only as one item of a list: Spec does not enable them, so doc "specs/*.yaml" is KDLITH-LOC004; SpecGlob does, so the list item set "specs/*.yaml" resolves, while the same pattern as pick's single SpecGlob value is KDLITH-LOC004 again, since a single value cannot hold a pattern's matches
